annotations.title: Look up GitHub Actions: latest release, commit SHA, runtime and inputs (live)

description: Use when a uses: line for a GitHub Action is about to be written and its current version, commit SHA or inputs are needed, or the user asks what the latest version of an action is, what SHA a tag points to, or whether an action or tag exists (signals: "latest actions/checkout", "pin setup-node to a SHA", "what inputs does this action take", "does v9 exist", "which version is this SHA"). Takes owner/repo (latest release), owner/repo@ref or owner/repo/path@ref, reads the tags and branches live from github.com and the action.yml at that commit, and returns per action: exists or not, the commit SHA, the release a SHA or major tag points to, the latest release and major tag, runs.using (flags node20 and older, which GitHub stopped shipping on 2026-09-23), retired versions that fail jobs, the declared inputs, and a ready-to-paste line: uses: owner/repo@<40-char sha> # vX.Y.Z. Example: {"actions":["actions/checkout","actions/setup-node@v4","docker/build-push-action@v6"]}. Up to 30 per call. Public github.com repositories only; for a whole workflow file use tack_check_workflow.

actions.description: Action references: "owner/repo" (latest release), "owner/repo@v4", "owner/repo/path@ref", or a full uses: line.

upgrade.description: For references with a ref, return the pinned line for the latest release instead. Default false.
